{{Quote|I am Makna-Ha and I have caused war. Voss kill Voss. Thousands dead. Only through war will Voss survive. Real war, not mock. Slaughter. I have seen. It was interpreted. The Three declared. It must be. I will spend eternity in tears.|[[Writings of Makna-Ha]]|<ref name="March of Time">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|March of Time|[[Voss]]}}</ref>}}
'''Makna-Ha''' was a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] living on [[Voss]] many years before the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society. Their vision showed the need for a civil war between the [[Voss (species)|Voss]]. As every vision was followed without question, a bloody conflict left thousands of Voss dead, but not Makna-Ha themself, who was devastated by their vision's result. Makna-Ha recorded their thoughts in the [[Writings of Makna-Ha]] on a carving outside the [[Shrine of Healing]] in the [[Old Paths]].
